units.source_text: 薰君送她回进了内室的纸门，自己就从昨夜进来的门里出去，

en.t: Kaoru escorted her back inside through the paper door of the inner room, then went out himself through the door by which he had entered the night before,

units.source_text: 躺下身子，然而不能入睡。

en.t: and lay down, but he could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 别后恋慕不已，想道：“倘我以前也如此恋慕，

en.t: After parting from her, his longing would not cease, and he thought, "If I had longed for her like this before,

units.source_text: 这几年来心情决不会如此平安吧。”

en.t: my heart could never have been so calm these past few years."
Then he felt unwilling even to return to Kyoto.
